[LIVE CHALLENGE] Plan, Build, Defend
sessions.desc: Builders tackle the same messy Malaysian problem in three stages: first, they decide what is actually worth solving; next, they build a usable solution under time pressure; finally, they defend their choices in front of judges. The session is designed to test product judgment, execution speed, and the ability to build something useful—not just impressive.
sessions.extra: Khalil Nooh ▸The Future Is Solo Danial ▸KrackedDev

sessions.title: [WORKSHOP] The AI-Powered SME: Work Smarter. Grow Faster.
sessions.desc: You don’t need a huge team or a huge budget to build a successful business today. You need to know how to put AI to work where it matters most. In this practical session, follow a fictional SME as it uses AI across four critical stages of growth to move faster, make better decisions, and do more with less. Research — uncover trends, track competitors, spot SEO wins, and generate content ideas Build — create ads, landing pages, prototypes, and branded content in less time Measure — connect AI to marketing and business data to surface insights that matter Scale — turn what works into repeatable Skills, systems, and team workflows

sessions.title: [PANEL] AI Nation: Malaysia’s Window to Lead
sessions.desc: A scene-setting panel on what it would actually mean for Malaysia to become an AI nation. Rather than speaking broadly about global trends, this session examines Malaysia’s practical strengths — its regional position, multilingual population, entrepreneurial base, and growing public-private momentum — and asks what it will take to turn AI enthusiasm into real execution, capability, and long-term advantage.
sessions.extra: Dr. Rainer Deutschmann ▸Axiata Amir Zakwan Anuar ▸500 Global Adrian Marcellus ▸CEO, MyDIGITAL

sessions.title: [SHOWCASE] Why Entertainment Makes AI Products Defensible
sessions.desc: A strategic showcase on why the hardest-to-copy AI products are not defined by model access alone, but by how well they win attention, shape behavior, and stay memorable in crowded markets. Through examples across products and user experiences, the session explores how entertainment value can strengthen engagement, differentiation, and long-term product advantage.

sessions.title: [PODCAST] Should Malaysia Copy Silicon Valley to Win AI?
sessions.desc: Malaysia is often told to “build the next Silicon Valley” — but strong universities, active VCs, and startup ambition are only part of the equation. This session asks what the US model gets right, why it cannot be copied wholesale, and what Malaysia must solve differently in talent, capital, and corporate adoption.
sessions.extra: Zubin Rada Krishnan ▸Partner, Hive Global AI Syed Haizam Jamalullail ▸Partner, Hive Global AI Kamesh Raghavendra ▸Partner, Hive Global AI

sessions.title: [FIRESIDE] The $10 Trillion AI Opportunity: What Enterprises Will Actually Pay For
sessions.desc: AI won’t just disrupt software. It will reshape the trillions of dollars enterprises spend every year on professional services. As consulting, tax, cyber, finance and operations evolve, a new generation of AI companies is emerging, not by building better models, but by delivering better business outcomes. Faster decisions. Lower costs. Reduced risk. Smarter workflows. Join this conversation to explore where the biggest commercial opportunities lie, how enterprise buyers evaluate AI, what makes an enterprise AI company defensible, and why the next category-defining businesses will be built around trust, domain expertise and measurable outcomes rather than technology alone.
sessions.extra: Vishy Narayanan ▸PwC Lee Kai Wen ▸Gamuda Technologies Joel Neoh ▸Founding Partner, Firstmove

sessions.title: [KEYNOTE] The Long Way Round: What Is Worth Forming When AI Has the Answer?
sessions.desc: Nobody quite knows how much AI an eight-year-old should be using. That uncertainty opens onto much larger questions: what it means to know something, what intelligence actually is, and what we are educating a person for once the machine can supply the answers. This talk follows that escalation from a parental worry to questions that technology may sharpen, but cannot answer without an account of what a human being is for.

sessions.title: The AI Model Olympics: 25 AI models put to the test. Who wins?
sessions.desc: Everyone knows ChatGPT and Claude, but there's a whole universe of models out there. But how do you choose which model to use, and which one is the best? In this session, Ashvin puts 25+ AI models to the test with live challenges (Basic vs Frontier, Claude vs ChatGPT, Gemini vs Deepseek, Open vs Closed); where you can choose your winners, understand the tradeoffs and become a better AI builder.

sessions.title: [MASTERCLASS] Work While You Sleep; Production Grade Development Cycle
sessions.desc: A high-speed masterclass on how top engineering teams are using AI to ship faster, tighten feedback loops, and keep product work moving even when the team is offline. Focused on real production environments, the session looks at how to turn AI from a coding assistant into a serious development advantage — helping teams build with more speed, consistency, and scale.
sessions.extra: Raunak Kathuria ▸Deriv, Vice President Of Engineering

sessions.title: [FIRESIDE] SMEs Don't Need AI Magic. They Need AI That Works.
sessions.desc: A practical discussion on the first layer of AI value for SMEs in Malaysia. Instead of advanced transformation talk, this session focuses on what smaller businesses actually need first: workflow simplification, lower admin burden, better customer response, and tools that are affordable, understandable, and fast to implement.
sessions.extra: Yuki AIZAWA ▸Women in Tech, APAC Director Mariel Asami Fukase ▸RoboFounders Firuz Alimov ▸The AI Collective Adele HOE ▸Solution Engineering Director, Microsoft

sessions.title: [SHOWCASE] The AI Talent Advantage: Future-Proofing Malaysia
sessions.desc: Don't just adapt to AI—master it. Join Coursera to unlock how Malaysian companies are leveraging global certifications to build agile, AI-first teams. 30 minutes to discover the exact learning blueprint your organization needs to thrive in 2026 and beyond.

sessions.title: [DEBUG] Save the Build
sessions.desc: A live rescue session where builders inherit a broken AI workflow and must turn it into something usable under pressure. As failures surface—bad prompts, brittle logic, broken chaining, weak UX, or unreliable outputs—the session reveals who can identify the real issue, make the smartest fix, and recover the build without overcomplicating it.

sessions.title: [Workshop] Designing Smart with Canva AI
sessions.desc: Discover how Canva AI can help you move from idea to polished design with greater speed and confidence. Explore intelligent tools that support brainstorming, content creation, image generation, layout design, and visual storytelling—helping individuals and teams produce professional presentations, campaigns, reports, and social content more efficiently. This session will show you how to combine creativity with AI to design smarter and communicate with impact.

sessions.title: [SUPERFIRESIDE] The Builders’ Economy: What it Takes to Win in AI
sessions.desc: Malaysia is attracting billions into data centres, infrastructure and AI. But infrastructure alone does not build an AI economy. Builders do. In just six years, Supabase has grown into a US$10 billion startup powering over 10 million developers worldwide. Today, it is the developer platform behind the AI generation, used by builders creating products with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Figma and thousands of AI startups. In this panel they'll discuss what it takes to build an AI nation.
sessions.extra: Paul Copplestone ▸CEO, Supabase Joel Neoh ▸Founding Partner, Firstmove

sessions.title: [Showcase] Can AI speak Manglish: watch us build a Voice AI Agent live
sessions.desc: Call our AI agent from your seat and try to break it - switch to BM mid-sentence, hear it come back with the lahs and local accent. Then see what's underneath, as we build a new agent live on stage. The tech is built by Malaysians in San Francisco, running today in major telcos and banks across SEA. We share how frontier tech gets localised.

sessions.title: LUNCH
[FIRESIDE] Malaysia’s AI Economy: From Capabilities to Competitiveness
sessions.desc: A strategic conversation on what it takes to turn AI capability into real economic value. From infrastructure, talent, and data to platforms and partnerships, the session explores how Malaysia can combine local strengths with global technologies to drive productivity, resilience, innovation, and long-term competitiveness.

sessions.title: [SHOWCASE] Your AI Twin Is Coming
sessions.desc: A bold look at the next wave of consumer AI — not chatbots you visit, but personal agents that know how you think, speak, and move through the world. This session explores how AI twins, assistants, and companions could reshape communication, coordination, and connection by acting on your behalf and reducing the friction of everyday life

sessions.title: [PODCAST] Building AI for How Malaysians Actually Learn
sessions.desc: A live conversation on designing AI learning experiences around real Malaysian behaviour, including mixed-language use, confidence gaps, conversational learning, and the everyday habits that turn occasional use into long-term learning.

sessions.desc: A demystifying session for participants who want to work with APIs but feel blocked by technical complexity or fear of getting started.

sessions.title: [Showcase] Empowering the AI-Ready Workforce
sessions.desc: As AI reshapes business, staying competitive requires an agile team. Join Peoplelogy for a 30-minute session exploring how their integrated ecosystem upskills talent and equips your organization to thrive in an AI-driven future.

sessions.title: [PANEL] AI Startups Need Customers, Not Just Capital
sessions.desc: A grounded conversation on why funding alone does not create a real AI business. This session explores what actually unlocks growth for Malaysian AI startups: early buyers, repeat use cases, trusted distribution channels, strategic partnerships, and customers willing to pay for real outcomes. Instead of asking only what investors want, the panel looks at what makes demand real enough for a startup to survive, learn, and scale.
sessions.extra: Ghazanfar Iqbal ▸Amazon Web Services (AWS) Dato' Munirah Looi

sessions.title: In a Sea of AI Slop: How to Design Things People Remember
sessions.desc: AI democratized execution, not creativity. While anyone can generate an app, a website, or a deck in seconds, most of it is instantly forgettable. In this session we go over what makes something worth remembering and the techniques you can apply in your products. Rachel breaks down her learnings on judgment, taste, and the human instincts AI can't replicate.

sessions.title: [ROUNDTABLE] Working with Corporates Without Getting Stuck
sessions.desc: A practical discussion on how startups and smaller teams can work with larger organisations without losing speed, clarity, or product direction. The session explores approval layers, expectation management, and how to avoid endless exploratory conversations.

sessions.title: [WORKSHOP] Don’t Get Left Behind: Practical AI for Business
sessions.desc: A hands-on session for business owners, managers, and teams who know AI is changing the way work gets done, but do not want to waste time chasing the wrong tools. The workshop focuses on the most useful ways to apply AI across everyday business tasks, helping participants spot quick wins, remove repetitive work, and understand where real advantage is starting to emerge. Clear, practical, and built for immediate use.

sessions.title: [PANEL] What Makes an AI Startup Fundable Now
sessions.desc: A candid investor view on how AI startups are judged now that hype alone is no longer enough. The session focuses on traction quality, retention, product clarity, defensibility, margins, and team credibility.
sessions.extra: Zubin Rada Krishnan ▸Partner, Hive Global AI
